title: Networking primer for AWS — quick overview
rememberThis: VPC CIDR /16, subnets /24 per tier per AZ — avoid overlap with on-premises ranges.
Route 53 ALIAS for AWS targets; CloudFront ACM cert must be in us-east-1.
Public subnet → IGW; private subnet → NAT for outbound; ALB public, app/DB private.
NAT per AZ; S3 Gateway endpoint avoids NAT data charges.
Troubleshoot OSI bottom-up: routing → SG → TLS → HTTP.
bullets: AWS reserves 5 IPs per subnet — /24 gives 251 usable addresses.
Security Groups are stateful and reference other SGs — prefer over 0.0.0.0/0 on app tier.
VPC Flow Logs show L3–4 ACCEPT/REJECT; ALB access logs show L7.
Lambda in VPC needs NAT or VPC endpoints for AWS API and internet access.
